recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-14689 unless a future work group decision changes the shared MetadataResource/CanonicalResource identifier wording policy.
issue_request: FHIR-14689 was a Published FHIR-core ValueSet change request from the 2018 January ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to change the ValueSet.identifier short text from 'Additional identifier for the value set' toward 'Business identifier for the value set'; the accepted modification was to append text so the boilerplate-compatible short reads 'Additional identifier for the value set (business identifier)'.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in svn 13337, represented in git as 345caf0941d33a36a6c438ee5dca22db1ea2f13d, which updated the then-authoritative ValueSet spreadsheet to add '& (business identifier)' for ValueSet.identifier. A later ValueSet documentation batch, d90f55e1cbc897c77c5188342e1d43353f38f2c3, also referenced GF#14689 while making non-substantive ValueSet ballot updates, but the direct identifier wording application was already present.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative source is source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml after later source refactors. Confluence block vote evidence for the Vocab WG call on 2018-04-19 lists tracker 14689 as Persuasive with Modification and pre-applied. Zulip search found only the committers bot notification for the implementation commit and no conflicting substantive discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ValueSet.identifier short text already reads 'Additional identifier for the value set (business identifier)', matching the accepted resolution, and the adjacent requirements text already describes business identifiers.
